mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a monetary tightening cycle causing labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates weakening supply chain activity and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1300.0 thousand units signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad-based economic expansion across demand and supply sides, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
